# Ricardo Augusto Kowalski

> Senior front-end engineer with 13+ years in web development, specializing in TypeScript, React, Next.js, and front-end architecture. Builds scalable PWAs, SaaS products, and AI-integrated web applications. Based in Timbó, Santa Catarina, Brazil. Open to senior front-end roles. Portfolio: https://rcrdk.dev

## Summary

Ricardo is a senior front-end engineer focused on architecture, performance, accessibility, and AI-powered product experiences. He works primarily in the JavaScript ecosystem (React, Next.js, TypeScript) and complements front-end work with Node.js (Fastify, NestJS) and PHP/Laravel when needed. He uses AI-assisted development in day-to-day workflows and is learning React Native.

The site https://rcrdk.dev is available in English (`en`) and Brazilian Portuguese (`pt-br`).

## Last role

- **Senior Front-End Engineer at MySide** (2025 – 2026, remote, Florianópolis, SC, Brazil), most recent position
- **Company:** Brazilian real estate startup, https://myside.com.br
- **Main product:** **Hero**, an internal AI-powered assistant used daily by 40+ Personal Shoppers for real estate service and negotiation workflows
- **Stack highlights:** React 19, Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, TanStack Query, Radix UI, shadcn/ui, TailwindCSS, PWA, Service Workers, IndexedDB, Google Maps API, Auth.js, Sentry, Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library
- **Deliverables:** Hero Mobile (PWA with AI chat, offline-first, IndexedDB conversation history) and Hero Desktop (Google Maps property search, negotiation pipeline, presentation tools)
